hero.sub: Coach, train alongside, or just be the reason someone shows up. List what you offer, set your own rates, and earn on your own schedule.

who.title_1: If people train better with you,
who.intro: Pacergo isn't only for trainers. Whatever you bring, you set your own rate.

items.name: Certified trainers
items.body: Verify your credentials and coach clients with structured programming.

items.name: Experienced athletes
items.body: Turn experience into sessions — train alongside people and share what works.

items.name: Motivating buddies
items.body: Be the accountability that gets people to show up. Start free or low-cost.

items.title: Create your listing
items.body: Add your activities and offerings. Verify credentials if you're a certified pro.

items.title: Set your own rates
items.body: You decide what each session costs and when you're available. No fixed pricing.

items.title: Accept & get paid
items.body: Approve the booking requests that fit, train, and get paid — on your schedule.

items.title: You set the price
items.body: Every offering is priced by you. Pacergo never sets your rates.

items.title: You choose the hours
items.body: Accept only the sessions and times that work for you. No quotas.

items.title: Keep your independence
items.body: No exclusivity and no chair to rent. Bring your own clients or find new ones.

items.title: Safety built in
items.body: Verified members, two-way reviews, and reporting protect every session.
